title: Completion-state persists per principal and the restart-tour control clears it
asA: returning principal who completed the tour
iWant: the completion state to persist per principal in the applied persistence store (or per browser in spa-local-storage as the Q4 fallback), and a restart-tour control I can reach from the settings surface
soThat: the tour does not re-open at every session, and I can bring it back deliberately when I need to

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a completed tour, the completion state persists per principal in the applied persistence blueprint (or in spa-local-storage as the Q4 fallback per ADR-2702 when no persistence blueprint is applied); a restart-tour control is reachable from the settings surface (composing on application-account-settings when applied; on any settings surface as a fallback); activating the control clears the completion state and re-opens the tour on the next principal load. Anchors to TAC-2703-application-onboarding-tour-completion-store; probed by application-onboarding-tour.pack.mjs check AC-26104-1.
When completion-state-store is and no persistence blueprint is applied, apply refuses with COMPLETION_STORE_MISSING_PROVIDER naming the required capability and no completion record is written.
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply exits with a non-zero code, COMPLETION_STORE_MISSING_PROVIDER is emitted and no completion record is written to any store

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the write of the completion record fails (a rejected persistence write or a full quota on spa-local-storage), the tour does not mark itself completed: the last step remains active or the dialog closes with data-error=COMPLETION_WRITE_FAILED, and the next principal load re-opens the tour.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a tour completing while the store rejects the write
acceptanceCriteria.then: no completed-success announcement is emitted, data-error=COMPLETION_WRITE_FAILED is logged, and a subsequent principal load re-opens the tour

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the read of the completion record fails on principal load (an unreachable persistence backend or a corrupted spa-local-storage entry), the tour defaults to first-run behaviour and the console log carries data-error=COMPLETION_READ_FAILED; the tour never claims dismissed status on an unreadable record.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a store that raises on read at principal load
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tour surfaces as first-run and data-error=COMPLETION_READ_FAILED is logged with the store kind
